mapper.select: SELECT /* LGVPAYP0013.retrieveContractList */ a.employee_no , to_char(a.contract_period_start_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS contract_period_start_date , to_char(a.contract_period_end_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS contract_period_end_date , c.common_code_name AS contract_info FROM tb_pay_emp_contract_n a , lgcom_common_code_c b , lgcom_common_code_multi_lang_c c WHERE b.common_code = a.contract_type_code AND b.code_type_code = 'IF_CONTRACT_TYPE' AND c.code_type_code = b.code_type_code AND c.common_code = b.common_code AND c.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} AND a.employee_no = #{employeeNo} ORDER BY a.contract_period_start_date DESC
